risks.title: Increased competition from neobanks and fintechs
risks.score_rationale: Risk is highlighted in the first section of Item 1A with strong language ('highly competitive', 'increased competition'). Trend is rising due to emergence of fintechs and technology-driven business models. Competition category is central to MS operations.

risks.title: Volcker Rule regulation and activity restrictions
risks.score_rationale: Volcker Rule is detailed in a dedicated Item 1A section with strict language and major operational implications. Trend is stable but risk remains elevated due to structural impact on trading and investment activities.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and technology dependency
risks.score_rationale: Risk is cited multiple times in forward-looking statements and risk factors with high alert language ('breaches or other disruptions'). Trend is rising with generative AI adoption. Cybersecurity is a critical pillar for MS.

risks.title: Downward pressure on asset management fees
risks.score_rationale: Risk is explicitly mentioned in Competition section with assertive language ('downward pressure on fees'). Trend is stable to declining but structural in nature. Directly impacts Investment Management segment profitability.

risks.title: Key talent dependency and employee retention
risks.score_rationale: Risk is cited in forward-looking statements and Competition with strong language ('attract and retain highly qualified employees'). Trend is rising in context of financial labor market tension. Central to operational performance.

risks.title: Technological innovation and AI disruption
risks.score_rationale: Generative AI and tokenization are cited in multiple sections with marked forward-looking language. Trend is clearly rising. This technology risk impacts multiple business segments.

risks.title: Unfavorable differentiated regulation
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Competition with competitive disadvantage language ('competitive disadvantage'). Trend is stable. This structural risk weighs on overall MS competitiveness.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence found in the 10-K filing.
